statement: What a card says its opponent cannot respond to "when" something is Summoned holds only if that Summon was the last thing to happen: outside a Chain, or as Chain Link 1 resolves.

sources.name: Clown Crew Meteor
sources.says: If the Tribute Summon was made by an effect activated as Chain Link 2 or higher, or anything else was done after it, then once that Chain has resolved it is no longer when the Tribute Summon succeeded, and the opponent can activate effects.

Clown Crew Meteor's effect applies when its controller Tribute Summons a monster, to either player's field (The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode to the opponent's): the opponent cannot activate effects then.

scripts: Clown Crew Meteor's script does the same.
